create_PrependTokenDataset: create a PrependTokenDataset that wraps an existing dataset and prepends a specified token to each item
use_getitem_PrependTokenDataset: use the PrependTokenDataset getitem method to retrieve a dataset item with a prepended token at a given index
check_sizes_PrependTokenDataset: check the sizes property of PrependTokenDataset to get sequence lengths adjusted for the prepended token
call_num_tokens_PrependTokenDataset: call num_tokens on PrependTokenDataset to get the token count for a specific index including the prepended token
